mechanism: Nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may precipitate withdrawal symptoms and reduce efficacy of venlafaxine in patients with concurrent opioid use, while venlafaxine increases serotonergic activity creating potential for serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use unless opioid antagonism is therapeutically indicated; if necessary, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms and ensure no recent opioid exposure; consider alternative treatments.
